born.sort: from the earliest born to the latest

rows.label: Harry Houdini
rows.description: Hungarian-born American illusionist, escapologist, and stunt performer (1874–1926)
rows.hook: escaped handcuffs, chains and locked tanks in front of crowds, becoming history's most famous escape performer

rows.label: David Copperfield
rows.hook: made a jet airliner vanish on live television and became the best-selling solo stage performer of all time

rows.label: Carisa Hendrix
rows.description: Canadian stunt performer, magician, and character comedienne
rows.hook: breathes fire and blends dangerous stunts with comic character performances on stage

rows.label: Harry Anderson
rows.hook: played a wisecracking judge on a hit American television courtroom comedy

rows.label: Penn Jillette
rows.hook: is the tall, talkative half of a famous two-man stage duo who exposes how tricks are done

rows.label: Georges Méliès
rows.hook: pioneered early trick photography and fantastical special effects in some of cinema's first films

rows.label: Tommy Cooper
rows.hook: wore a red fez and let his tricks go hilariously wrong on purpose for laughs

rows.label: Teller
rows.hook: is the silent half of a famous two-man stage duo and never speaks during their act

rows.label: David Blaine
rows.hook: has been frozen in a block of ice and buried alive for days in extreme endurance stunts

rows.label: Criss Angel
rows.hook: starred in a reality television series showcasing elaborate street and stage illusions

rows.label: Uri Geller
rows.hook: claims to bend spoons using only the power of his mind

rows.label: James Randi
rows.description: Canadian-American stage magician and skeptical movement adherent
rows.hook: offered a large cash prize to anyone who could prove paranormal powers under fair test conditions

rows.label: Derren Brown
rows.hook: predicted the national lottery numbers live on television using psychological technique

rows.label: Suhani Shah
rows.hook: began performing solo stage shows as a child prodigy and became a well-known mentalist

rows.label: The Amazing Johnathan
rows.hook: performed gruesome-looking fake stunts for shock and laughs as a comedy stage act

rows.label: Paul Daniels
rows.hook: hosted a long-running British television show that made stage magic mainstream in his country

rows.label: Stephen Mulhern
rows.hook: presents popular British television game shows while also performing close-up magic
